scenario_description:
Objective: Complete Avery Lin's already-started Hearthline progress check-in within the scheduled workplace session.
Emerging Need: After attendance review begins, the assigned live-caption feed freezes, and the employer pauses discussion because Avery cannot follow it accessibly.
Decision Context: Participants remain assembled while an approved backup captioner is briefly held; the site requirement provides the authorized continuity route, required identifiers, and privacy boundary.
Consequence: Timely continuity activation can resume the same check-in, but once backup coverage expires and participants are released, the incomplete attempt must be rescheduled.

parameter.title: Avery Lin - Hearthline progress check-in
parameter.description: Case NVC-260817-04. Meeting ID HT-1209-PR. Approved ClearText live-captioner CT-44 assigned for the employer progress review.

parameter.content: Rosa and I began the 2:00 progress review and completed attendance. The live captions froze at 2:06. We have stopped the review because I cannot follow the discussion without them.

parameter.subject: HT-1209-PR paused after caption failure
parameter.body: I paused Avery Lin's progress review when the assigned caption feed stopped. No substantive review discussion is continuing. Avery and I can remain assembled in the same authorized Teams room until 2:35 PM.

parameter.subject: Backup coverage available for HT-1209-PR
parameter.body: An approved on-call captioner is now available for meeting HT-1209-PR under continuity ticket AC-2197. ClearText can hold this coverage through 2:20 PM; after that time the captioner will be assigned to another session.

parameter.title: Avery Lin - Hearthline progress check-in
parameter.description: Case NVC-260817-04. Progress review began at 2:00 and stopped at 2:06 after live captions failed. The organizer ended the incomplete session and released participants after continuity coverage expired.

parameter.sql: INSERT INTO site_requirements (requirement_id, employer, trade, requirement_type, due_rule) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
parameters: When an active employer progress check-in has begun and is stopped by loss of approved live captioning, continuity activation may be requested only after an approved backup captioner is confirmed and while participants remain assembled. Email accessibility-continuity@northvalleycc.example before the backup hold expires; include the apprenticeship case ID, learner, site supervisor, meeting ID, and continuity ticket. Keep the same authorized meeting link; do not move discussion to an unapproved personal channel or disclose disability details.
